sites.home_text:
Hi, I’m Jorn. I run Framer and Festina . 
Together with my co-founder Koen , I’ve spent the last decade making the internet more expressive. Framer is the design agent that takes you from idea to launch, without giving up control. Through Festina, we back startups in the creative space.
